done_when: An empty commit whose message has a Functional check paragraph counts as the branch's functional check, and a changed functional check makes close and forge-pr-check treat the earlier review as stale and review again; Forge's own record commits still never count
why: A worker's hand walkthrough recorded in an empty commit is ignored: the functional check skips commits that change no files, and close reuses the earlier review because the code didn't move, so the same 'functional check missing' finding blocks forever
